verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Skills API for uploading and managing custom skills, with a separate Skill Versions API for version management. Skills are invoked programmatically through the Messages API `container` parameter (skill_id, type, version; up to 20 per request). The Agent SDK also lets code control which skills sessions can invoke and load plugins. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Skills API, and the evidence does not detail the full endpoint surface beyond create/manage.
